cards.card_text: Jesus keeps going, friend: “But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.” Son of Man is the name Jesus uses for Himself (Mark 2:10).
cards.verse_text: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

cards.card_text: Jesus has told the council the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.
cards.verse_text: So they all asked, “Are You then the Son of God?” He replied, “You say that I am.”
